# Setup

```{r packages used composition}
library(stringr)
library(ggpubr)
library(vegan)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library("Rmisc")
library("ggh4x")
library("glmmTMB")
library("DHARMa")
library("data.table")
library(microshades) #remotes::install_github("KarstensLab/microshades")
```

Read in data

```{r read in data}
#paths are relative to this .Rmd's folder (03.comm.comp), which is the working directory when knitting

ps.clean1 <- readRDS("../01.make.asv.table/ps.ready.rds")

##ASV count table (all 39 samples, before removing clonemates)
#write.csv(data.frame(ps.clean1@otu_table),file="ready.otutab.csv")

##clonemates removed (KA = KG, VB = VD; one of each pair kept)
ps.clean <- subset_samples(ps.clean1,genotype_original!="KA" & genotype_original!="VB")
ps.clean #31 samples

samdf <- data.frame(ps.clean@sam_data)
samdf$treat_time <- paste0(samdf$treatment,"_",samdf$timepoint)
ps.clean@sam_data <- sample_data(samdf)
```

# PCoA (manuscript Fig. 3C)

Bray-Curtis dissimilarity of relative abundances

```{r pcoa rel}
ps.rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps.clean, function(x) x / sum(x))

ord.rel <- ordinate(ps.rel, "PCoA", "bray")
round(ord.rel$values$Relative_eig[1:2]*100,1) #17.4, 9.7 - used in axis labels below

plot.pcoa <- plot_ordination(ps.rel, ord.rel,color="treat_time",shape="host_species")
plot.pcoa.data <- plot.pcoa[["data"]]

##reorder
plot.pcoa.data$treat_time <- factor(plot.pcoa.data$treat_time,levels=c("control_preheat","control_postheat","thermvar_preheat","thermvar_postheat"))

gg.pcoa.rel <- ggplot(plot.pcoa.data,aes(x=Axis.1,y=Axis.2,color=treat_time,group=treat_time))+
  stat_ellipse()+
  geom_point(aes(shape=host_species),size=2)+
  scale_shape_manual(name="Host",values=c(16,17),labels=c(expression(italic("O. faveolata")), expression(italic("O. franksi"))))+
  scale_color_manual(name="Priming x Heat",values=c("#2C2673","#9187FF","#E24A13","#FFA45E"),labels=c("Stable-Primed","Stable-Heat","DTV-Primed","DTV-Heat"))+
  labs(title="Bacterial communities")+
  xlab(paste0("PCoA1 (",round(ord.rel$values$Relative_eig[1]*100,1),"%)"))+
  ylab(paste0("PCoA2 (",round(ord.rel$values$Relative_eig[2]*100,1),"%)"))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.title=element_text(size=14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14, face = "bold", color="black"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),title=element_text(face="bold",size=16))
gg.pcoa.rel
```

## Multi-panel figure (manuscript Fig. 3C-D)

The Shannon panel uses the per-sample diversity values saved by `../02.diversity/dtv.16s.div_revised.Rmd`, plotted the same way as in that script. P-values and the legend layout in the manuscript figure were added afterwards by hand (stats from the GLMM below and from the `lmer` models in `02.diversity`).

```{r multi panel}
df.div <- read.csv("../02.diversity/dtv.16s.alphadiv.csv")
df.div$timepoint <- factor(gsub("preheat","Primed",gsub("postheat","Heat",df.div$timepoint)),levels=c("Primed","Heat"))
df.div$host_species <- paste0("O. ",df.div$host_species)
df.div$treat_time <- factor(df.div$treat_time,levels=c("contr_pre","contr_pos","therm_pre","therm_pos"))
df.div.se <- summarySE(data=df.div,measurevar="Shannon",groupvars=c("treat_time","treatment","timepoint","host_species"))

gg.shan.both <- ggplot(df.div,aes(x=timepoint,y=Shannon,shape=treat_time,fill=treat_time))+
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=0.1, seed=1),alpha=0.3,size=4)+
  geom_errorbar(data=df.div.se,aes(ymin=Shannon-se,ymax=Shannon+se),position=position_dodge(width=0.5),width=0.2)+
  geom_point(data=df.div.se,aes(x=timepoint,y=Shannon),position=position_dodge(width=0.5),size=5)+
  facet_grid2(~host_species, strip = strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c("#8B7355","#CDAB7D")),text_x = elem_list_text(size = 14, face = "bold.italic", color = "white")))+
  scale_fill_manual(name="Priming x Heat",values=c("#2C2673","#9187FF","#E24A13","#FFA45E"),labels=c("Stable-Primed","Stable-Heat","DTV-Primed","DTV-Heat"))+
  scale_shape_manual(name="Priming x Heat",values=c(22,22,23,23),labels=c("Stable-Primed","Stable-Heat","DTV-Primed","DTV-Heat"))+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.title=element_text(size=14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14, face = "bold", color="black"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"))+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("Shannon index")

gg.beta.alph <- ggarrange(gg.pcoa.rel,gg.shan.both,nrow=2,labels=c("C","D"))
gg.beta.alph

ggsave("fig3CD_bact.pdf",gg.beta.alph,height=6,width=6)
ggsave("fig3CD_bact.png",gg.beta.alph,height=6,width=6)
```

# GLMM (manuscript stats for community composition)

## Setup

```{r glmm setup}
##retaining sample sums
otu.all <- data.frame(ps.clean@otu_table,check.names=FALSE)
sam.all <- data.frame(ps.clean@sam_data)
all(row.names(otu.all)==row.names(sam.all))
sam.all$counts.sum <- rowSums(otu.all)
ps.clean@sam_data <- sample_data(sam.all)
```

## Trim

Keep ASVs present in > 9% of samples (i.e. at least 3 of 31)

```{r glmm trim}
table(ps.clean@sam_data$treatment)
table(ps.clean@sam_data$timepoint)
table(ps.clean@sam_data$host_species)

ps.clean.trim1 <- filter_taxa(ps.clean, function(x) sum(x > 0) > (0.09*length(x)), TRUE)
ps.clean.trim1 #103 taxa, 31 samples

##any samples missing data
ps.clean.trim <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps.clean.trim1) > 0, ps.clean.trim1)
ps.clean.trim #none missing

##proportion of zeroes after
otu.trim <- data.frame(ps.clean.trim@otu_table,check.names=FALSE)
sum(otu.trim == 0) / (ncol(otu.trim) * nrow(otu.trim)) * 100 #84.3%

##before
otu.before <- data.frame(ps.clean@otu_table)
sum(otu.before == 0) / (ncol(otu.before) * nrow(otu.before)) * 100 #93.3%
```

## Long format

```{r glmm long}
otu.trim$sample_name <- row.names(otu.trim)

otu.tot1 <- plyr::join(otu.trim,sam.all, by="sample_name", type="left")

##getting rid of some irrelevant metadata
otu.tot <- otu.tot1 %>%
  dplyr::select(-genotype_original,-fragment,-treat_time)

tot.long <- reshape::melt(otu.tot, id.vars=c("sample_name", "host_species","treatment","timepoint", "genotype","counts.sum"))
```

## Models

- variable = ASV id
- value = the counts for ASVs

```{r glmm models}
##note: with control=glmmTMBControl(profile=TRUE) the full nb1 model gave a non-positive-definite Hessian
##(no log-likelihood) under glmmTMB 1.1.14, so default settings are used; all models below converge
mod.tot.nb1 <- glmmTMB(value~timepoint*treatment+host_species+offset(log(counts.sum))+(1|genotype)+(1|variable)+(1|variable:genotype)+(1|variable:treatment)+(1|variable:timepoint)+(1|variable:host_species)+(1|variable:timepoint:treatment), family=nbinom1, data=tot.long)
summary(mod.tot.nb1)

mod.tot.nb2 <- glmmTMB(value~timepoint*treatment+host_species+offset(log(counts.sum))+(1|genotype)+(1|variable)+(1|variable:genotype)+(1|variable:treatment)+(1|variable:timepoint)+(1|variable:host_species)+(1|variable:timepoint:treatment), family=nbinom2, data=tot.long)
summary(mod.tot.nb2)

##convergence checks (should all be TRUE)
mod.tot.nb1$sdr$pdHess
mod.tot.nb2$sdr$pdHess #FALSE: nb2 does not converge cleanly, another reason to use nb1

AIC(mod.tot.nb1,mod.tot.nb2)
mod.tot.nb1.resid <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = mod.tot.nb1, plot = T)
mod.tot.nb2.resid <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = mod.tot.nb2, plot = T)
##nb1 is better
```

Likelihood ratio tests (manuscript Fig. 3C p-values)

```{r glmm lrt}
##DTV x Heat
mod.tot.nb1.noint <- update(mod.tot.nb1,.~.-(1|variable:timepoint:treatment))
anova(mod.tot.nb1,mod.tot.nb1.noint) #Chisq = 1.20, p = 0.27

##DTV
mod.tot.nb1.notrt <- update(mod.tot.nb1.noint,.~.-(1|variable:treatment))
anova(mod.tot.nb1.noint,mod.tot.nb1.notrt) #Chisq = 0, p = 1

##Heat
mod.tot.nb1.notim <- update(mod.tot.nb1.noint,.~.-(1|variable:timepoint))
anova(mod.tot.nb1.noint,mod.tot.nb1.notim) #Chisq = 1.03, p = 0.31

##Species
mod.tot.nb1.hos<- update(mod.tot.nb1.noint,.~.-(1|variable:host_species))
anova(mod.tot.nb1.noint,mod.tot.nb1.hos) #Chisq = 0, p = 0.99
##all n.s., as in manuscript Fig. 3C
```

# Average relative abundance

## Functions

```{r functions}
fast_melt = function(physeq){
  # supports "naked" otu_table as `physeq` input.
  otutab = as(otu_table(physeq), "matrix")
  if(!taxa_are_rows(physeq)){otutab <- t(otutab)}
  otudt = data.table(otutab, keep.rownames = TRUE)
  setnames(otudt, "rn", "taxaID")
  # Enforce character taxaID key
  otudt[, taxaIDchar := as.character(taxaID)]
  otudt[, taxaID := NULL]
  setnames(otudt, "taxaIDchar", "taxaID")
  # Melt count table
  mdt = melt.data.table(otudt,
                        id.vars = "taxaID",
                        variable.name = "SampleID",
                        value.name = "count")
  # Remove zeroes, NAs
  mdt <- mdt[count > 0][!is.na(count)]
  # Calculate relative abundance
  mdt[, RelativeAbundance := count / sum(count), by = SampleID]
  if(!is.null(tax_table(physeq, errorIfNULL = FALSE))){
    # If there is a tax_table, join with it. Otherwise, skip this join.
    taxdt = data.table(as(tax_table(physeq, errorIfNULL = TRUE), "matrix"), keep.rownames = TRUE)
    setnames(taxdt, "rn", "taxaID")
    # Enforce character taxaID key
    taxdt[, taxaIDchar := as.character(taxaID)]
    taxdt[, taxaID := NULL]
    setnames(taxdt, "taxaIDchar", "taxaID")
    # Join with tax table
    setkey(taxdt, "taxaID")
    setkey(mdt, "taxaID")
    mdt <- taxdt[mdt]
  }
  return(mdt)
}

summarize_taxa = function(physeq, Rank, GroupBy = NULL){
  Rank <- Rank[1]
  if(!Rank %in% rank_names(physeq)){
    message("The argument to `Rank` was:\n", Rank,
            "\nBut it was not found among taxonomic ranks:\n",
            paste0(rank_names(physeq), collapse = ", "), "\n",
            "Please check the list shown above and try again.")
  }
  if(!is.null(GroupBy)){
    GroupBy <- GroupBy[1]
    if(!GroupBy %in% sample_variables(physeq)){
      message("The argument to `GroupBy` was:\n", GroupBy,
              "\nBut it was not found among sample variables:\n",
              paste0(sample_variables(physeq), collapse = ", "), "\n",
              "Please check the list shown above and try again.")
    }
  }
  # Start with fast melt
  mdt = fast_melt(physeq)
  if(!is.null(GroupBy)){
    # Add the variable indicated in `GroupBy`, if provided.
    sdt = data.table(SampleID = sample_names(physeq),
                     var1 = get_variable(physeq, GroupBy))
    setnames(sdt, "var1", GroupBy)
    # Join
    setkey(sdt, SampleID)
    setkey(mdt, SampleID)
    mdt <- sdt[mdt]
  }
  # Summarize
  summarydt = mdt[, list(meanRA = mean(RelativeAbundance),
                         sdRA = sd(RelativeAbundance),
                         minRA = min(RelativeAbundance),
                         maxRA = max(RelativeAbundance)),
                  by = c(Rank, GroupBy)]
  return(summarydt)
}
```

## Phyla & families

```{r phylum family summaries}
ps.phy <- tax_glom(ps.clean,taxrank="Phylum")
ps.phy.rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps.phy, function(x) x / sum(x))

sum.phy.rel <- data.frame(summarize_taxa(ps.phy.rel, "Phylum"))
sum.phy.rel.arr <- sum.phy.rel[order(sum.phy.rel$meanRA,decreasing=T),]
head(sum.phy.rel.arr)

ps.fam <- tax_glom(ps.clean,taxrank="Family")
ps.fam.rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps.fam, function(x) x / sum(x))

sum.fam.rel <- data.frame(summarize_taxa(ps.fam.rel, "Family"))
sum.fam.rel.arr <- sum.fam.rel[order(sum.fam.rel$meanRA,decreasing=T),]
head(sum.fam.rel.arr,10)
```

# Microshades plot (manuscript Fig. S8)

```{r microshades}
mdf.ps <- prep_mdf(ps.rel,subgroup_level="Family")

# Create a color object for the specified data
col.mdf.ps <- create_color_dfs(mdf.ps, top_orientation = FALSE,group_level="Phylum",subgroup_level="Family",selected_groups=c("Proteobacteria", "Bacteroidota", "Cyanobacteria", "NB1-j"),cvd=TRUE)

#Extract
col.mdf.ps.m <- col.mdf.ps$mdf
col.mdf.ps.c <- col.mdf.ps$cdf

#both species, just used for the legend
ms.plot.both <- plot_microshades(col.mdf.ps.m, col.mdf.ps.c,x="genotype")+
  theme_cowplot()+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Phylum-Family"),fill=guide_legend("Phylum-Family"))

col.mdf.ps.m$treatment <- gsub("control", "Stable",col.mdf.ps.m$treatment)
col.mdf.ps.m$treatment <- gsub("thermvar", "DTV",col.mdf.ps.m$treatment)
col.mdf.ps.m$treatment <- factor(col.mdf.ps.m$treatment, levels=c("Stable","DTV"))
col.mdf.ps.m$timepoint <- gsub("preheat", "Primed",col.mdf.ps.m$timepoint)
col.mdf.ps.m$timepoint <- gsub("postheat", "Heat",col.mdf.ps.m$timepoint)
col.mdf.ps.m$timepoint <- factor(col.mdf.ps.m$timepoint, levels=c("Primed","Heat"))
col.mdf.ps.m$genotype <- gsub("KA_KG", "KA-KG",col.mdf.ps.m$genotype)
col.mdf.ps.m$genotype <- gsub("VB_VD", "VB-VD",col.mdf.ps.m$genotype)

col.mdf.ps.m.fav <- subset(col.mdf.ps.m,host_species=="faveolata")
col.mdf.ps.m.fra <- subset(col.mdf.ps.m,host_species=="franksi")

ms.plot.fav <- plot_microshades(col.mdf.ps.m.fav, col.mdf.ps.c,x="genotype")+
  facet_grid(timepoint~treatment,scales="free")+
  xlab("Genet")+
  theme_cowplot()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),legend.position="none")+
  ggtitle(expression(italic("O. faveolata")))
ms.plot.fav

ms.plot.fra <- plot_microshades(col.mdf.ps.m.fra, col.mdf.ps.c,x="genotype")+
  facet_grid(timepoint~treatment,scales="free")+
  xlab("Genet")+
  theme_cowplot()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),legend.position="none")+
  ggtitle(expression(italic("O. franksi")))
ms.plot.fra

ms.plot.fav.fra <- ggarrange(ms.plot.fav,ms.plot.fra,ncol=2,labels=c("A","B"))

legend <- cowplot::get_plot_component(ms.plot.both, "guide-box-right", return_all = TRUE)

gg.ms.bac.multi <- plot_grid(
  ms.plot.fav.fra, legend, ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.6)
)
gg.ms.bac.multi

ggsave("gg.ms.bac.revised.pdf",gg.ms.bac.multi,width=10.5,height=4.5)
ggsave("gg.ms.bac.revised.png",gg.ms.bac.multi,width=10.5,height=4.5)
```
